title: Row 579 (DEG2 = C6): the last open row of the one-sided ledger, 603/603 KILLED; follow-up to #3154
body:
Follow-up to #3154 (`research/p112-reduction-to-conjectures`). No kappa claim, no window, no supplier word. Pure finite combinatorics on the E8 root lines.

## What this adds
- `research/p112-row579-deg2/` closes conjecture C6 = DEG2 of #3154 (ledger row 579 [7^8,4,4,4,3], d = 8). Chain: Theorem K5 (no five sevens with an A4 pair pattern, size-only) and Lemmas K5^- and K5^-2 give at least 6 non-root pair directions among the 28 pairs; the only possible non-root types are D7, E6A1, E6, A7, D6 (minimum leftovers 14, 23, 24, 25, 26; all other supports >= 31); DEG2 (no seven carries two non-root pair directions) makes the non-root graph a matching, e_N <= 4 < 6, a contradiction.
- DEG2 is closed in a mask model (necessary conditions only: finite mask set, parallel exclusion, Lemma F triangle condition, |union| <= 28, 3F4+F3 cover); `MODEL.md` proves that this is a sound relaxation of Lemma F. Implementation A (`DEG2A`): 4-seven survivors only for La-orbit reps 1 and 8, five-sets exist, six-sets 0 (all 10 reps; rerunnable in chunks). Implementation C (`DEG2C/d2fix.c`, an independently written search with the FIXED cover oracle; a bug in the first version of its oracle was found and fixed, see `MODEL.md`): six-sets 0.
- Ledger: `data/ledger4_consolidated.csv` = #3154's ledger3 with row 579 KILLED: 603/603 KILLED, recomputed by `verify.sh`.
- Every claim has a rerunnable check with two implementations where claimed; `PROOF_MAP.md` maps claim to check; `verify.sh` default run reproduces K579T (impls A and B), R579b K5^-/K5^-2 (impls A and B), the type list, the DEG2 impl A five-/six-set stages, the DEG2 impl C controls (K=3/K=4) and the coverage check of the recorded shards; `FULL=1` adds pairmin, every quad-stage chunk and the 64 impl C shards.

## Impl C rerun (former open slot, now filled)
Impl C (`checks/DEG2C/d2fix.c`, fixed cover oracle), K=6, MODE 0, all five h_ab types (D7, A7, E6A1, E6, D6): **six-set count 0 over 64 rc=0 shards**, which cover every (type, L_0-orbit-rep shard) exactly once (`checks/DEG2C/coverage.py`; 33 shards at NS=8, 27 at NS=32, 4 at NS=128; 7 first-run timeouts were split into finer shards, 10 timed-out or killed outputs are listed and not used). Controls: the all-root configurations are found at K=3 and K=4. Oracle validation: fixed oracle agrees with impl A's cover oracle on 400/400 sets (the old scalar-flag oracle disagreed on 79/400). Impl A and impl C therefore agree (six-sets 0), and the row-579 kill is unconditional within the mask model. `verify.sh` reruns the controls first and checks coverage of the recorded shard outputs; `FULL=1` reruns all 64 shards (hours).

## Credit
- conorholds' #3166 closed C7 (the d = 0 sliver). With this PR (C6) the whole one-sided case K2 (L120 suffices, via #3074) is complete.
- petalas's C5 work (#3158 to #3185) is progress on C5 (two-sided FINITE beta R = 7, p = 4), which this PR does not touch; the two-sided case K1 still depends on C1-C5.

## How to check
`PYTHON=/path/to/python3 bash verify.sh [outdir]` (Python >= 3.11 with numpy, cc; <= 3 processes, each under `timeout 1200`), `FULL=1 bash verify.sh` for the heavy reruns.
